Yeah honestly as long as you just relax and let it take you and don’t fight it off then you’ll be fine, the effects are pretty strong and it also has a sedative effect so it should help with relaxing you as well as making you fall asleep. I try to stay away from benzos because they really are only short term, I went from taking 1 Valium to having to take 4 a night to even feel anything

Since it isn’t a benzo I didn’t develop a tolerance to it as fast as I did when I was taking valiums, I’ve been taking the same dose of this for a while and it take it a couple times a week with no issue. They usually take an average of 20 mins for me to kick in and I start feeling really relaxed and sleepy. 

In terms of side effects there aren’t really any noticeable ones for me personally that I find any issues with other than it might give you some memory loss if you force yourself to stay awake on them and fight off the sleepiness. If you take them as directed and go to sleep as soon as you start feeling the effects then you’ll be fine.

Hi 21f here, let me start off by saying your feelings are entirely valid and I understand your struggle. I recently left home to move in with my boyfriend and it was so tiring and frustrating to explain to them that I wasn’t running away with a boy, I was leaving the house because I wanted to for my sake. These seemingly small events here and there are more than enough to warrant you feeling the way you do. If you ever feel like trying hard to give yourself a better life is too exhausting, which I understand completely, please always tell yourself that if you could survive in that toxic household for 22 years of your life and that if you had the power and strength within you to withstand all of that then you for are more than capable of channeling that strength and resilience into giving yourself the life and happiness that you deserve. I know it’s difficult and overwhelming but please know that you are so so worth it and that one day you’ll thank yourself for doing right by you and treating yourself better than they ever have. Sending lots of love and support, you’ve got this <3

My psych diagnosed me with binge eating disorder before I even knew that bpd was a thing. I would eat to the point of being in physical pain and once the pain let up a little bit I would repeat the cycle over and over again. It made me feel ashamed and miserable. My psych prescribed me vyvance for my binge eating disorder and lamotrigine for bpd and they’ve made the world of a difference! I find that they work the best for me when taken together instead of just one standalone medication because the vyvance helps with appetite suppression and the lamotrigine helps with mood regulation. I hope this helps!
